rotunda.name: The Rotunda
rotunda.subtitle: a roof around a promise
rotunda.lore: The builders meant this chamber for an audience. Malgrath made it a place to sleep. The gold is softer than the stone, he told me once, though I think he only liked the sound it made when he settled. I still sweep a path to the water.
rotunda.note: Inner courts cover several passes with one defense. Holding the Rotunda opens the way to the Rift.

rift.name: The Rift
rift.subtitle: a wound that learned to glow
rift.lore: There was a bridge here before either of us arrived. The stone remembers its ends; the middle remembers nothing. Heat comes through the crack at night. Malgrath used to warm his wings above it. Now I keep watch from the cooler bank.
rift.note: Separate banks need separate defenses. Holding the Rift opens the Long Halls.

halls.name: The Long Halls
halls.subtitle: footsteps before faces
halls.lore: Every doorway is smaller than the one before it, until the far end seems built for someone else entirely. Malgrath disliked the echoes. I liked knowing who was coming. These days I can count a guild formation without seeing a single boot.
halls.note: The long road rewards reach and repeated coverage. Holding the Halls opens the Garden.

garden.name: The Sunken Garden
garden.subtitle: something growing in the dark
garden.lore: The roots found the water before we did. I thought the pale leaves meant the tree was dying. Malgrath said I was judging it by the wrong sky. There are flowers here that have never seen daylight. They open anyway.
garden.note: Slow the front ranks and catch the crowd at the bends. Holding every fixed floor unseals the Heart.

heart.name: The Heart
heart.subtitle: what the walls are for
heart.lore: There is no gold in the deepest chamber. Only warmth, and a hollow worn into the stone by a body that once filled the sky. I used to call every room in this place a defense. Here I remember what I am defending.
heart.note: Thin the outer ranks; finish survivors near the heart. Win all four fixed floors on this renown to enter. Holding the Heart opens the Depths.

depths.name: The Unmapped Depths
depths.subtitle: the stone has another answer
depths.lore: My first map was wrong by morning. My second was wrong before I finished it. The lair continues beneath the places we know, folding its roads around something I have not found. I take a torch, and leave the old map where Malgrath can see it.
depths.note: Routes change with the seed. The Depths open after the four floors and Heart are held on this renown.
